text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in model_variant_mismatch (x-rate 4.2k/m) + routing fallback churn across us-west/us-east. Error stream shows repeated 'assign_to_incompatible_pool' and 'region-fallback-loop' for hosted -> dedicated assignments. Paging oncall.

frank-oncall: Got the page. Looking now. Any customer-facing impact reported?

carla-cs: ACME reported increased 502s and higher latencies since ~12:41 UTC. Also seeing retries from three other tenants (team-green, orbit-data, ledgerx). CS is triaging and collecting logs.

alice-runtime: Quick triage: the smart-router's policy engine returned mixed signals after the latest rules push (feature-flag: dynamic-tiering=true). It started treating capacity-tier thresholds as soft and allowed spillover to dedicated, but the model-mapping table in dedicated doesn't contain the new quantized variant, so assignments fail and trigger region fallback. That fallback then re-routes back to hosted in a loop.

dawn-sre: Confirming logs: hostrouter logs show repeated route decision retries and a TTL bump on KV cache for tenant pins, causing re-evaluations. CPU on router pods spiked.

frank-oncall: Mitigation plan? We should throttle the policy and stop new spillovers.

alice-runtime: Agreed. Immediate mitigations I propose: 1) flip dynamic-tiering feature-flag -> off 2) set spillover.mode=conservative 3) pin affected tenants to hosted while we repair dedicated model mappings.

ben-platform: I can flip the flags via ops-api. Running:

ops-bot: Executing request: POST https://internal-api.ops.redwood/v1/flags/dynamic-tiering -> false

ops-bot: Executing request: PATCH https://internal-api.ops.redwood/v1/spillover/config -> {"spillover.mode":"conservative"}

ben-platform: Done. Commands: (internal)
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.ops.redwood/v1/flags/dynamic-tiering -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"value":false}'
curl -X PATCH https://internal-api.ops.redwood/v1/spillover/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"spillover.mode":"conservative"}'
```

frank-oncall: Good. I'm manually pinning the four affected tenants to hosted: team-green/orbit-data/ledgerx/ACME. Doing now.

ops-bot: tenant-pin applied: ACME -> hosted (by frank-oncall)
ops-bot: tenant-pin applied: team-green -> hosted (by frank-oncall)
ops-bot: tenant-pin applied: orbit-data -> hosted (by frank-oncall)
ops-bot: tenant-pin applied: ledgerx -> hosted (by frank-oncall)

carla-cs: ACME confirms reduced 502s after the pin. They still see latency ~20% higher but requests are succeeding. I'll send a note and set expectation that we're rolling a fix.

alice-runtime: Next step: repro the model-mapping gap in dedicated. Hypothesis: latest model onboarding job skipped variants for certain quantization profiles in eu/us regions due to gating rule mismatch. I'm rolling a job to reconcile mapping tables.

dawn-sre: Also scaling router pods + adding a 30s debounce to decision loop to prevent immediate re-evaluations while reconciliation occurs.

frank-oncall: Handover: I'm assigning to alice-runtime and ben-platform for the incident lead. I'll stay on stand-by for pages. Owner: alice-runtime.

alice-runtime: Taking lead. Creating incident doc and adding checklist.

ops-bot: Incident doc created: /incidents/2767812345-routing-threshold-fallback-surge (internal)
eve-product: Product/Trust: Please coordinate messaging for affected customers and mark ACME/ledgerx as high-priority. We should also check SLA impact window and prepare comms.

carla-cs: On it. Drafting email to ACME ops with root cause summary and mitigations in progress.

alice-runtime: Reconciliation job output (summary): found missing mapping entries for variants: 'rw-quant-16k-q4' in dedicated/us-west-2 and dedicated/us-east-1. Likely a merge conflict in onboarding manifests. Re-applied mapping and triggered warmup.

dawn-sre: Router CPU returning to baseline. Decision churn reduced. Observability: model_variant_mismatch errors down from 4.2k/m to 120/m in 10 minutes.

ben-platform: Rolling back smart-router rules push (commit 9a1f3 -> revert to 9a1f2). Done.

alice-runtime: Warmup succeeded for the missing variants. Starting controlled unpin: will move ledgerx back to its previous tier first, then orbit-data, then team-green, then ACME. We'll watch for regressions and stop if churn returns.

frank-oncall: Please make sure a canary unpin is tested per our SLA playbook.

alice-runtime: Canary unpin ledgerx -> initiating.

ops-bot: tenant-unpin started: ledgerx (by alice-runtime)

carla-cs: ledgerx reports normal latency after unpin.

alice-runtime: Rolling next: orbit-data -> initiating.

ops-bot: tenant-unpin started: orbit-data (by alice-runtime)

frank-oncall: Monitoring traces. No fallback loops observed for now.

alice-runtime: Completed unpins for all four. System appears stable. Metric summary: fallback churn < 5/min, error rate back to baseline.

eve-product: Good. Next steps: postmortem, tighten gating for onboarding manifests, add automated mapping validation hook in CI, and adjust default spillover policy to conservative until we have more robust variant verification.

dawn-sre: Also adding a debounce in the routing decision loop and a circuit-breaker when mapping mismatches exceed threshold.

carla-cs: Communicated status to ACME and other tenants. They appreciate quick response; requested ETA for permanent fix. I'll coordinate follow-ups.

frank-oncall: Closing page for now. Handoff complete to alice-runtime and ben-platform for post-incident work. If anything recurs, re-open with new page.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigations applied). Duration: ~28m. Severity: Sev2 -> downgrading.

alice-runtime: Adding notes to incident doc and creating follow-ups: (1) CI validation for mapping tables, (2) revert gating regression, (3) run a canary deployment for policy changes.

ops-bot: Follow-up tasks created in backlog: INFR-4821, RTE-3910, CS-2104.

frank-oncall: Thanks team. Leaving final sign-off to alice-runtime.

alice-runtime: Signing off for now. Will post full postmortem in #postmortems when ready.

ops-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x6, :rotating_light: x2
